title: Explanation Integrity Benchmark (EIB): attribution rewriting attacks on intrusion detectors explained to machines
description:
A benchmark of prediction-preserving attacks on the post-hoc feature attributions that ML-based NIDS attach to their alerts.

Ships: three attacks (rank promotion, cause displacement, and Slack-style explainer scaffolding); per-instance detector-relative interventional labels; a realizable-flow constraint that enforces the arithmetic each flow extractor imposes on its own output; runtime integrity signals calibrated label-free by split conformal prediction; and a downstream decision task in which an autonomous triage agent reads the explanation and its decisions are scored objectively.

Datasets are not redistributed. The code is MIT-licensed; each corpus carries its own academic-use terms and is fetched from its original host.
